messages.name: anything
messages.description: A filepath or filename within the Max search path will set which file is to be watched by.

messages.name: int
messages.description: Turns on theobject. Sending a non-zero number causes theobject to commence watching the file for changes. Sending a 0 causes the object to ignore changes to the file.

messages.name: stop
messages.description: Themessage functions the same as sending a 0, causing the object to ignore any file changes.
